scripts.features:
Fishy Hub is a dynamic automation and quality-of-life suite for Jump for Animals! that discovers the game's modules, remotes, and attributes at runtime so it survives updates without hardcoded names. It handles the full collect-carry-place-hatch loop with configurable rarity filters and jump gate respect, plus safety features like returning before the map's periodic collapse. The anti-rollback protection blocks your client from firing the drop request when guards touch you, making them harmless since the server trusts that local call. Additional tools include a slap aimbot, carrier hunting, server hopping, ESP visuals, and a full Obsidian UI with save manager support.

Auto Collect seamlessly steals, carries, and places eggs while respecting your rarity filters, jump gate limits, and the cave collapse timer.
Guard Drop Block prevents your client from calling the drop request when a guard touches you, effectively negating guard-based egg loss.
Server Hop scans for your target rarities and teleports to a new server if none exist, re-executing the script after the hop through a queued loader.

scripts.title: Jeff The Killer Animations!
scripts.script:
-- Jeff The Killer Anim GUI 🔪
-- Client-sided LocalScript

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
if not Player then return end

--// SETTINGS
local ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://252557606"

--// GUI
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "JeffTheKillerAnimGUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = Player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Main = Instance.new("Frame")
Main.Name = "Main"
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 110)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.5, -55)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
Main.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4 -- 40% opacity
Main.BorderSizePixel = 0
Main.Parent = ScreenGui

local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
Corner.Parent = Main

local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
Stroke.Thickness = 2
Stroke.Parent = Main

--// TITLE
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "Jeff The Killer Anim GUI 🔪"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.TextSize = 18
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.Parent = Main

--// TOGGLE BUTTON
local Toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
Toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 210, 0, 45)
Toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -105, 0, 52)
Toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
Toggle.BackgroundTransparency = 0 -- 100% opaque
Toggle.Text = "JEFF RUN: OFF"
Toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Toggle.TextSize = 16
Toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Toggle.AutoButtonColor = true
Toggle.Parent = Main

local ButtonCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
ButtonCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
ButtonCorner.Parent = Toggle

local ButtonStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
ButtonStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
ButtonStroke.Thickness = 1.5
ButtonStroke.Parent = Toggle

--// VARIABLES
local Enabled = false
local Character
local Humanoid
local Animator
local RunTrack
local MoveConnection

--// CREATE ANIMATION
local function SetupCharacter(char)
    Character = char
    Humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    Animator = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not Animator then
        Animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        Animator.Parent = Humanoid
    end

    if RunTrack then
        pcall(function()
            RunTrack:Stop(0)
            RunTrack:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    local Animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    Animation.AnimationId = ANIMATION_ID

    RunTrack = Animator:LoadAnimation(Animation)
    RunTrack.Looped = true

    -- Higher priority helps prevent the default run animation
    -- from immediately overriding it.
    RunTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    if MoveConnection then
        MoveConnection:Disconnect()
    end

    MoveConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            return
        end

        if Enabled then
            local Moving = Humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05

            if Moving then
                if not RunTrack.IsPlaying then
                    RunTrack:Play(0.15)
                end
            else
                if RunTrack.IsPlaying then
                    RunTrack:Stop(0.15)
                end
            end
        else
            if RunTrack and RunTrack.IsPlaying then
                RunTrack:Stop(0.15)
            end
        end
    end)
end

--// TOGGLE
Toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Enabled = not Enabled

    if Enabled then
        Toggle.Text = "JEFF RUN: ON"
        Toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 0, 0)
    else
        Toggle.Text = "JEFF RUN: OFF"
        Toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)

        if RunTrack and RunTrack.IsPlaying then
            RunTrack:Stop(0.15)
        end
    end
end)

--// CHARACTER
if Player.Character then
    task.spawn(SetupCharacter, Player.Character)
end

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    task.wait(0.5)
    SetupCharacter(char)
end)

--// DRAGGABLE GUI
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPos

Main.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = Main.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

Main.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

        dragInput = input
    end
end)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (
        input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
    ) then

        local delta = input.Position - dragStart

        Main.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale,
            startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale,
            startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

scripts.title: Snowy Hub | Auto Farm, Auto Fire, Auto Loot, TP & More
scripts.features:
Automation and prompts

Auto Fire Prompts – Automatically triggers nearby ProximityPrompts with filters for Lost Items, Auction Items, Safes, NPCs, or All.

Instant Prompts – Activates detected prompts in the area simultaneously without movement.

Auto NPC Offers – Automatically accepts NPC trade offers when the profit percentage meets the selected minimum.

Auto Rewards – Automatically claims Daily Rewards and available Achievement rewards.

Station Automation – Automatically collects completed items from Washing and Grading stations.

Garage Finder – Automatically finds and walks to the nearest Auction Garage.

Inventory and shop management

Auto Sell – Automatically sells selected inventory items at a set interval based on rarity filters.

Auto Stock – Automatically places inventory items into your shop for sale.

Price Multiplier – Adjusts stocked item prices from 0.5x to 3x their base value.

Auto Place All – Attempts to stock all supported inventory items at once.

World utilities and ESP

Lost Item ESP – Highlights Lost Items through walls and displays their rarity.

NPC ESP – Highlights NPCs around the map.

Vehicle ESP – Highlights active vehicles in the world.

ESP Filters – Controls render distance up to 2,000 studs and filters items by minimum rarity.

Travel and teleports

Area Teleports – Provides instant travel to key locations including Junk Yard, Back Alley, Farm Yard, Shipyard, Lucky Beach, Power Plant, Business Bay, and Shopping Mall.

Plot Teleport – Instantly returns you to your shop plot.

Safe Teleport – Uses controlled movement and velocity resets for smoother destination travel.

Player and interface

WalkSpeed Boost – Adjusts movement speed from 16 to 400 studs/s.

Infinite Jump – Allows repeated jumping while airborne.

Anti-AFK – Prevents the game from kicking you for inactivity.

Menu Keybind – Changes the key used to toggle the SnowyHub interface, defaulting to RightShift.

Unload – Completely removes the script and interface from the current session.
